claim: gbrain and code-review-graph BOTH use bge-m3 embeddings (1024-dim, local Ollama). Unified vector space = semantic search consistency across both tools. gbrain config: provider=openai (misnomer, means OpenAI-compatible API), model=bge-m3, base_url=http://localhost:11434/v1. CRG wired via MCP .mcp.json to same Ollama endpoint. ADR-045 recommendation: keep both systems on bge-m3 for semantic coherence.

decisions.notes: Earlier session (2026-05-24) unified embeddings across both tools. This session confirmed: gbrain needs explicit configuration to use Ollama bge-m3.
